tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal bsam yas kyi chos skyong tse'u dmar po'i sku rten pa khri smon sde par byung dus rten 'brel sku chas sogs phul ba'i phrin bskul bzhugs so// kyai/ dbang drag rol pas phyogs bcu dus gsum du/ /gzugs 'dzin 'khrul 'joms dgra bgegs tshar gcod phyir/ /'dod khro'i nyams ldan phrin las thogs med lha/ /tse'u dmar gnod sbyin chen po deng 'dir dgongs/ /khyod sngon khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa dang / /rgyal dbang pad+ma la sogs 'phags grub tshogs/ /gangs khrod rdo rje 'dzin pa ji snyed dang / /khyad par 'khon ston rim byon spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar dam tshig zhal bzhes rjes dgongs la/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen rnal 'byor pa/ /lhag bsam rab dkar kun dga' blos gros kyis/ /thugs dam rjes brtses bskul ba'i phrin 'di gson/ /'dzam gling bstan 'gro spyi dang bod yul gyi/ /dge legs kun 'byung dpal gyi bsam yas zhes/ /gtsug lag rten dang brten pa ngo mtshar smad/ /srung zhing skyong bar las smon dam tshig can/ /pe har dpon blon gu ru pad+ma yis/ /mnga' gsol gnyer gtad ji bzhin zhal bzhes ltar/ /dam gtsang skal bar ldan par zhal gzigs nas/ /blang dor gnas kun gsal bar lung bstan te/ /bstan 'gro'i mel tshe g.yel ba med pa'i rgyun/ /mi nyams dbyar mtsho lta bur rgyas pa'i phyir/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab snyigs 'gro'i mgon/ /gang gis khyod thugs bskul zhes stsal ba ltar/ /bdag gis dngos bsham yid sprul mchod gtor bcas/ /rang gzhan rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /bskang bshags thugs dam nan bskul gsol ba bzhin/ /'phrin las ming ldan rlom rten 'di nyid dam/ /khyed lung gsal ba'i skal ldan gzhan yang rung / /'khrul med gnas dus spyi dang bye brag la/ /zhal gzigs lung bstan stsol zhig sa mā ya/ /dmigs med rjes brtse'i mdangs ldan dbu thod dang / /rngams brjid btsan gos spyan stong rnam par bkra/

/dwangs gsal 'khor 'das 'char ba'i a dar+sha/ /sna tshogs phrin las mdzad phyir dar tshon bcas/ /lnga bdo'i bza' bca' btung ba la sogs pa/ 'joms zhing dkar phyogs rgyal ba'i mdung / dregs pa zil gnon gcan gzan lpags pa'i wam/ las bzhi'i/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te/ /ris med bstan pa'i bdag po'i drung bdar nas/ /dam tshig gdug pa kun 'ching btsan zhags dang / nag phyogs/ rten 'brel ched du 'bum lags na/ /bslu med rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs dang / /chos skyong mthu rtsal can gyi nus pa dang / /rgyal tshab rnam 'dren dam pa'i thugs bskyed dang / /bdag gi mos blos drug ldan rten gyi tshogs/ /kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshor bzhes nas kyang / /thub pa'i bstan pa srung shig gnod sbyin che/ /bstan 'dzin dbu 'phang bstod cig 'phrin las mgon/ /gtsug lag chos 'khor skyongs shig tse dmar ba/ /bstan 'gro'i dgra bgegs sgrol zhig bshan pa che/ /snod bcud legs tshogs spel zhig dgra lha'i rgyal/ /ji ltar smon bzhin myur 'grub 'phrin las mdzod/ /dam can mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dpal sa skya/ /mkhas grub rim byon pho brang gzhi thog nas/ /za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor kun blo yis/ /rtse gcig bstan 'gro'i don du snyan bskul zhus/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ tsi'u dmar po'i sku rten par rten 'brel sku chas sogs phul ba'i phrin bskul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
